extractionMethod.provisionalAjami: Canonical-mapping.json supplies consonants and approved short-mark inventory supplies a clearly labeled fallback. No word becomes approved; unresolved carrier, vowel-length, h, apostrophe, cluster, numeral, and language-routing decisions remain explicit.
